logline: The showdown, behind the Lanes: the dumpster, the neon, and the culprit — a gull, with the torn page in its beak, on the sign. The dog can't climb. The caption says he had the gull cornered. The gull leaves with the page. Case closed, says the caption. It isn't.

panels.composition: The alley at night, the sign all lit, the dumpster, the dog in the trench coat looking up.
panels.caption: I knew where it would end. It always ends behind the Lanes.

panels.caption: There he was. The page in his mouth. Two strokes of a bird.
